method.access: Read-only retained files on dl3; no access to the released compute node, no GPU work, no capture rerun, no analyzer changes.
method.raw_trace_read: Decoded the entire retained gzip and parsed its Chrome trace JSON in a login-node Python process bounded by timeout 60s, CPU limit 45s and address-space limit 2GiB; command completed in 5.9s.
checks: SHA-256 of the retained gzip matches the COMPLETE capture receipt and source analysis.
Independently counted invalid complete events, positive kernels, selected CPU ranges and annotation thread identities.
Independently recomputed clipped GPU/kernel interval unions and gaps inside the selected CPU range.
Reviewed source analyzer correlation and same-thread containment rules; attribution totals are from the SHA-bound source analysis, not a second independent correlation implementation.

event_integrity.finding: The 393 exclusions do not indicate a truncated trace or missing positive-duration GPU work.

cpu_elapsed_basis.rationale: Use the two complete schedule CPU annotations for elapsed forward/backward reporting. They include dispatch and waits. Autograd executes the checkpoint-backward scopes on another thread, so same-thread GPU attribution to the outer backward annotation is incomplete by design. Nested categories are not additive.

gpu_activity.coverage_interpretation: This is time covered by recorded positive-duration activity intervals on rank0/device0. It is not physical GPU utilization, occupancy, idle time, or a measurement of all devices.

correlation_attribution.limits: The outer backward's two kernels are not total backward GPU cost. Autograd thread7318 has the 48 checkpoint recompute-plus-backward scopes; unique External ID/runtime correlations associate 13560 kernels with those scopes. Pure recomputation is not separately timed. Conflicting links remain ambiguous.

host_dispatch_observations.interpretation: Many short kernels, numerous CUDA API calls and distributed gaps support host dispatch/software scheduling/profiler perturbation as candidates to investigate. The 1752.758ms uncovered activity interval cannot be assigned wholesale to host launch overhead, GPU idle, communication wait, or a hardware cause. CUDA API time alone does not account for that interval.

gpu_annotation_caveat.interpretation: The matching gpu_user_annotation is only 2.498us and does not bound this F+B sample. Analysis correctly selects the complete 2048.4935ms CPU annotation and its boundary-synchronized activity. Do not report the GPU annotation duration as microbatch elapsed time.

report_limits: One profiled rank0 microbatch is not a complete optimizer update or the entire actor-update timer.
Optimizer and final gradient synchronization are outside the trace; pure recompute is inseparable from backward here.
Inclusive CPU scopes and correlated GPU category unions overlap and must not be summed.
Profiler instrumentation and capture-boundary synchronization perturb elapsed time; use separate unprofiled updates for throughput comparisons.
No paired Rubin trace was assessed here. This GB-only trace does not explain or prove the prior 1.77x system-level actor-update difference or a GPU-only hardware effect.
